ranks: Top-5000 recheck (2026-10-16): the cards whose triage needs had all been built since (cards:needs --stale), re-briefed; the ones still blocked re-recorded with the precise need; and Desert Warfare (B87) and Mechan Shieldmate, unblocked the same day by the delayed-trigger and entered-as-it-entered fixes

blocked.name: Flare of Fortitude
blocked.why: The lifeCantChange player-effect and the hexproof/indestructible grants are built, but the alternative cost 'You may sacrifice a nontoken white creature rather than pay this spell's mana cost' has no shape: card.alternativeCost is mana plus tapping creatures only (Sephara), and cost:alt-cost-sacrifice is still unbuilt (Flare of Cultivation, Duplication, Malice, Denial wait on it too).

blocked.name: Doc Samson, Super Psychiatrist
blocked.why: 'If you would put one or more counters ... that many plus one of each of those kinds' has no 'effect' qualifier, so it applies to counters put as a cost (a planeswalker's +N loyalty cost, Devoted Druid's -1/-1, Wall of Roots' -0/-1, Jessica Jones' stun), which the engine puts without consulting would-add-counter (game.ts loyaltyCost path and putCostCounters); and it only applies when you are the one putting them, while counterTotal adds the plus for any counters put on your permanents, an opponent's -1/-1 counters included.

blocked.name: Pir, Imaginative Rascal
blocked.why: 'If one or more counters would be put on a permanent your team controls, that many plus one' has no 'effect' qualifier (contrast Doubling Season's ruling), so it adds a loyalty counter to a planeswalker's +N loyalty cost and a counter to Devoted Druid's/Wall of Roots' cost counters; the engine puts cost counters (loyaltyCost in activateAbility, putCostCounters) without any would-add-counter replacement.

blocked.name: Platinum Emperion
blocked.why: "Your life total can't change" as a permanent's static ability: what's built (2026-10-12) is only the temporary `player-effect` `lifeCantChange` (Teferi's Protection); nothing makes it last while a permanent is on the battlefield.

blocked.name: Absolute Virtue
blocked.why: "You have protection from each of your opponents" (rule 702.16k) as a static: what's built is only the temporary `player-effect` `protectionFromEverything`; protection from players (no damage, Auras or targeting from anything an opponent controls) has no form.

blocked.name: Winding Constrictor
blocked.why: The permanent half is Hardened Scales' `plus` over any kind on artifacts and creatures, but "if you would get one or more counters, you get that many plus one" needs the same replacement over counters a player gets (poison, energy, experience); `would-add-counter` covers permanents only.

blocked.name: Jace's Machinations
blocked.why: "Until end of turn, you may activate loyalty abilities of Jace planeswalkers you control on any player's turn any time you could cast an instant": instant-speed loyalty exists only as a permanent's own static (`loyaltyAtInstantSpeed`, Teferi, Master of Time), not as an effect granting it to a set of planeswalkers for a duration.

blocked.name: Stensian Sanguinist
blocked.why: Prepare is built, but "whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player this combat" needs a watch that ends with the combat: the delayed dealsCombatDamage watch lasts the turn, so an additional combat would prepare it again.

blocked.name: Camellia, the Seedmiser
blocked.why: Forage was built as an effect (2026-10-15), not as a cost ("{2}, Forage: …"), and "whenever you sacrifice one or more Foods" needs a trigger batched per sacrifice event.

blocked.name: Feed the Cycle
blocked.why: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, forage or pay {B}": forage is built only as an effect, not as a cost (here a choice of additional costs).

blocked.name: Thornvault Forager
blocked.why: "{T}, Forage: Add two mana in any combination of colors": forage is built only as an effect, not as a cost; the mana itself has precedent (Orb of Dragonkind's any-combination mana).
